questions.question: Describe your experience participating across the SDLC, from requirements reviews through release sign-off and production support. How did you ensure quality at each stage?
You have led QA team members and conducted test-case peer reviews. How did you provide technical direction, resolve disagreements, and maintain testing standards across the team?
Walk us through a complex defect you identified in an e-commerce, banking, or payment application. How did you investigate the root cause, communicate the impact, and drive it through resolution?

This role works closely with business partners and solution architects. How have you translated business requirements, use cases, and technical specifications into clear test scenarios or solution feedback for both technical and non-technical stakeholders?
Describe your experience working in Agile delivery teams using JIRA. What was your role in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, estimation, defect triage, reviews, and release readiness?
What SQL or PL/SQL queries have you written to validate application data? Please give an example where database validation uncovered an integration or business-process issue.

You have automated sanity and regression tests using Selenium, Java, TestNG, and Page Object Model concepts. How did you decide which business processes to automate, and how did you maintain the suite as the application changed?
Describe how you have managed testing for deployments, production patches, hot fixes, or monthly releases. What entry criteria, validation activities, risks, and sign-off information did you use?

What is your experience with Oracle Cloud Fusion Financials, Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Cloud EPM, BI Publisher, or OTBI reporting? If your direct experience is limited, how would you approach learning and testing an Oracle Cloud financial integration?
In one of your projects, how did you identify application risks or quality issues early, prioritize them with the team, and recommend corrective actions before a release?
